title: 0214 - WF-24 frame wavefront measured (OFF-BOARD): the 24-adic 4-waveform object (past/future x absolute/relative per prime class r = p mod 24) is real and machine-validated; the beginning->end propagation law holds AS A T-WAVE (F_24 near-identity hole settles to exactly the 0909 antipode difference 42.0; imH transient = 21/t to 0.1% over t<=40; tau_12 identity-propagation exact to 5e-9); zero-height sensitivity is MEASURED ABSENT in BOTH regions (settled t<=404: ratio 1.0001 at 204 zeros; live t in [400,1200] C1: 612 zeros vs 1224 matched controls ratio 1.0000, 95% CI [0.995,1.005], per-zero peak rate 0/610); the live wave (C2, 3201-pt DFT) is APERIODIC (no ln24/ln(N/24/2pi) component above 0.6%) with algebraic growth |imH-21/t| = 3.7e-5*t linear over t in [400,1200]; the origin of the growing hole (finite-N artifact vs true structure) is the named C4 N-ladder test; no predictive power claimed (816 zeros, honest null)
body: Owner side-quest (2026-10-29): measure the 'wave front' of the 24-adic frame - a reading at the beginning and at the end of the 24-adic, prime treated as always (class r = p mod 24), giving 4 waveforms (future/past x relative/absolute), and test whether how the 'holes' propagate end<->beginning carries predictive power. Built and ran scripts/sq/wf24_wavefront.py (single-threaded mpmath, dps-30, 4 cores open by construction; output tmp/sq24/wf24_out.txt; full report docs/WF24-FRAME-WAVEFRONT-2026-10-29.md, OFF-BOARD status). OBJECT: v(r; N=1e6, t) = (n1^{S+1}/S)[sum_j c_j 24^{-S} zeta(S, nf_j/24) + P[r] n1^{-S}] with S = 1/2+it, n1 aligned to phase r, nf_j = first integer in class j (mod 24) with nf_j >= n1+1 (the residue-class tail above the cut); 4 waveforms per class = {v(r0), v(r0)-mean24, v(r0+12), v(r0+12)-mean24}; holes H_id = v(r0+12)-v(r0), H_sf = v(r0+12)+v(r0). MACHINERY GATES (all PASS): (1) my lattice port reproduces a verbatim day006-original port at dev 6e-4 (c2 curvature, 5 sampled phases); (2) tau_12 3-cut M1 constants reproduce the 0909 recorded table [2,2,1,0,-1,-2,-2,-2,-1,0,1,2] to max 8e-10 (well-conditioned external gate; the 0909 dps-40 6-cut F_24 rerun is flagged ill-conditioned in its own output and was NOT used as a gate); (3) F_24 antipode difference at t=10 = 41.948 matches the independent 0909 recorded 42.0. IMPLEMENTATION TRAP DOCUMENTED: the Hurwitz argument is nf/q = (j + q*ceil((n1+1-j)/q))/q (the first lattice point of the class ABOVE the cut), NOT the naive (n1+1-j)/q - the naive argument is off by a full unit interval and moves the F_24 M1 constants by O(7e5) while the 1/N tail structure looks superficially fine; the trap is caught only by the well-conditioned tau_12 table. MEASURED: (a) |A|(t) ~ 1.75e6/t smooth decaying pole phasor (phase-blind envelope, past=future to 7 digits); (b) relative waves settle: pastW -> (-28.125, 0), futW -> (13.875, 0); (c) the identity-propagation hole H_id(t) = (41.354, 5.169) at t=4 settling to (42.00, 0) by t~40 - the 0909 antipode difference as a T-WAVE; imH = 21/t to <0.3% over t in [4,40] (21.0126 61-pt fit, RMS 1.75e-3); (d) tau_12 control: H_id ~ 5e-9 (identity propagation exact, multiplicative cell law), H_sf = 4.000007 common mode - the two 0909 cell laws confirmed as t-waves with roles swapped. ZERO TEST (t in [4,404], 204 certified zeros from scripts/rh/lowt/zeros_0_to_1p2e3.dec20.txt): mean |H_id| at zeros / uniform grid = 1.0001 - the hole is a function of t alone, FLAT across zero heights; no reH kink across the 4 in-band zeros; prime-own-reading in [g +/- g/ln g] windows gives r=1/5/7/11 ratios 0.869/1.012/0.859/0.869 to Poisson = the known small-prime bias at p<700, no new signal. SECOND CUT (t=800,1600): the settled hole is NOT dead - reH drifts above 42 (42.0015 at 1600) and imH REVERSES (0.0558 at 800 -> 0.0723 at 1600): a live second wave of amplitude ~0.05-0.07 (0.15% of the hole) for t >= 800, period unmeasured. VERDICT: the 4-waveform frame wavefront is a real machine-validated object and the propagation law holds as a t-wave (new datum vs 0909's single constants); in the settled region t<=404 the hole carries NO zero-height information and no prime-window information beyond the known small-prime bias - no predictive power there, honestly reported; the live region (t >= 800, where the 813 certified zeros up to 1.2e3 live) is where the 'do holes propagate' question has a chance. NAMED NEXT CUTS: C1 = high-t live wave vs zeros/local density on [400,1200] with matched off-zero controls (the predictive-power test; ~1.5 min); C2 = DFT of the high-t residual for the live wave's period (candidates ln 24 = 3.18, ln(N/24/2pi) = 8.8); C3 = prime-window reading at scale p ~ t (primes to 2000); C4 = N-ladder (1e7/1e8) - 42.0 and 21/t stay, live-wave frequency N-stable predicted; C5 = other cells/q (tau_24, tau_30, q=30,60). C1 and C2 were executed this entry with the null/aperiodic results above (C1: 612 certified zeros in [398,1202] vs 1224 matched off-zero controls, mean|imH| ratio 1.0000 with 95% CI [0.995178, 1.0049], reH ratio 1.0, per-zero peak rate 0/610, density bins within 1sigma; C2: DFT of the residual on a 3201-point grid t in [400,1200] over 0.2..12 rad/t - no peak at ln 24 = 3.178 or ln(N/24/2pi) = 8.8 or anywhere else above the 0.6% level (top amp 1.7e-4); |imH-21/t| grows LINEARLY with t: bin means 0.018494/0.025893/0.033293/0.040693 across 200-t bins = slope 3.7e-5 to <1%, i.e. imH(t) ~ 21/t + c(N)*t with c(1e6) ~ 3.7e-5, aperiodic algebraic growth). No RH claim: off-board side quest, borrows the day006 M1 machinery only, all numbers finite/reproducible; the B6 watcher daemon and critical path are untouched (board re-checked quiet mid-run: 41 records, top = in-tree face, no markers).
